$comment: What a figma-batch session returns (claude -p --json-schema). figpipe record stores it and renders the report from it. Paths are relative to the batch folder or absolute.

summary.description: One line for the notification and the report header: what was built and what needs Tony.

change_kind.description: copy shows a text diff in the report; redesign and new_page show before/after captures at every width

verdict.description: One plain-English line: what happened. No hedging, no novel.

captures.description: One row per width. before is the page before this batch (omit for new pages), after is the build, figma is the design render at the same width.

text_diff.description: For copy changes: each changed string, verbatim.

decisions.description: Choices made without the designer, each with the default already applied.

questions.description: Questions for the designer, written ready to paste. States the build proposed are asked by figpipe from components; do not repeat them here.

flags.description: Looks unconsidered: missing empty or loading states, copy that differs across breakpoints, mobile quirks, motion without reduced-motion. A missing hover, focus, checked, error, disabled or open state goes under components, not here.

components.description: Where the states of each interactive element came from. One row per element; a second row for the states that came from somewhere else. figpipe writes the report's Components line from these rows, and turns every row with another source than figma_component into a question asking whether those proposed states are wanted.

element.description: The element in plain words: Checkbox, Phone list.

states.description: The states this row covers, when it is not all of them: open, or hover and focus.

source.description: figma_component: the variants of its component set, with their interactions. figma_elsewhere: the same element shown in that state elsewhere in the file. project: the project's existing component or tokens. platform_default: the platform's usual states for that kind of element, for a project with nothing to follow.

used.description: For every source but figma_component, what was used, in plain words: the site's existing dropdown.

reply.description: For comment items: a reply Tony can paste into the thread. Never posted.
